patches.name: 0001-winebus.patch
patches.subject: A USB pad's container comes from its location ID, so a game can pair it with its audio

patches.name: 0002-winecoreaudio.patch
patches.subject: The pad's audio endpoints answer DEVPKEY_Device_ContainerId with the pad's container

patches.name: 0003-mmdevapi.patch
patches.subject: An active endpoint's container is asked of the driver, not read from the registry

patches.name: 0004-winebus-bluetooth.patch
patches.subject: A Bluetooth DualSense or Edge is shown to the game as the same pad on a cable

patches.name: 0005-winecoreaudio-bluetooth.patch
patches.subject: A Bluetooth pad gets the audio output its wired self would have, for its haptics

patches.name: 0006-winebus-xinput-and-triggers.patch
patches.subject: XInput's rumble on the pad's motors, trigger effects chosen in Game Feel, a steadier Bluetooth stream

patches.name: 0007-hidclass-xinput.patch
patches.subject: A pad with a haptics collection is also offered to XInput

patches.name: 0008-xinput-sony-order.patch
patches.subject: XInput reads a Sony pad's own descriptor in Sony's order

patches.name: 0009-mmdevapi-setupapi-endpoints.patch
patches.subject: Audio endpoints are listed through SetupAPI as Windows lists them, with the pad's container

patches.name: 0010-setupapi-base-containerid-wchar.patch
patches.subject: SetupDiGetDeviceRegistryPropertyA returns SPDRP_BASE_CONTAINERID as a WCHAR string, as Windows does

patches.name: 0011-xaudio2-mastering-voice-device.patch
patches.subject: An XAudio2 mastering voice opens the device the game names, not the default one

patches.name: 0012-winecoreaudio-edge-output-name.patch
patches.subject: An Edge shown as a DualSense has the DualSense's audio device on a cable too

patches.name: 0013-winebus-dualshock4.patch
patches.subject: The pad shown to a game as a USB DualShock 4 (pad_as=dualshock4)

patches.name: 0014-winebus-trigger-replace-and-live-settings.patch
patches.subject: A chosen trigger effect can replace the game's own, and Game Feel's changes reach a running game

patches.name: 0016-winebus-rumble-flag-0x02-keeps-the-motors.patch
patches.subject: Over Bluetooth a game report with the rumble flag 0x02 alone keeps the motors, as the pad does on a cable

patches.name: 0017-ntdll-rosetta-cpu-fidelity.patch
patches.subject: Under Rosetta the CPU looks more like the x86 one copy protection checks for: CPUID leaf 7 bits on request, CLWB and RDPID, debug-register breakpoints, non-canonical faults

patches.name: 0018-ntdll-d3dmetal-fallback.patch
patches.subject: A 64-bit process with CX_GRAPHICS_BACKEND=d3dmetal finds D3DMetal's DLLs first, even when CrossOver did not route it

patches.name: 0019-ntdll-rosetta-smc-cpuid.patch
patches.subject: Under Rosetta, a cpuid that self-modifying code wrote right before running it, which Rosetta skips and faults after, is run by ntdll

patches.name: 0020-ntdll-rosetta-cpuid-by-default.patch
patches.subject: Rosetta's CPUID bits are on for every process unless WINE_ROSETTA_CPUID7_OR=0, and each emulated CLWB or RDPID is counted in the log

patches.name: 0021-ntdll-timer-relative-overflow.patch
patches.subject: NtSetTimer keeps a relative expiry near -MAXLONGLONG from overflowing in wineserver; Wine 11.0's own threadpool never sets one, a program may

patches.name: 0026-ntdll-dualstack-ipv4-options.patch
patches.subject: An IPv4 option macOS refuses on an IPv6 socket (IP_DONTFRAGMENT, IP_TTL, IP_MULTICAST_TTL, IP_MULTICAST_LOOP) is set as its IPv6 counterpart, which reaches the socket's IPv4-mapped traffic: FH6 keeps its dual-stack UDP game socket and joins online sessions; both sides, ntdll.so

patches.name: 0027-ntdll-dualstack-ipv4-options-switch.patch
patches.subject: WINE_DUALSTACK_IPV4_OPTIONS=0 turns 0026 off for a program, which then sees macOS's refusal as before; on by default; both sides, ntdll.so

patches.name: 0028-ntdll-direct-syscall-under-suspend.patch
patches.subject: Under Rosetta, a thread that makes a system call with a syscall instruction of its own while another thread suspends it is no longer lost and no longer skips the call: a SIGSYS that lands on top of the suspend handler, or never arrives, is entered when that handler is done; WINE_DIRECT_SYSCALL_DEFERRAL=0 turns it off; Intel side, ntdll.so

patches.name: 0029-ntdll-exception-ahead-of-suspend.patch
patches.subject: Under Rosetta, an exception raised by a thread that another thread is suspending no longer ends it with 'nested exception on signal stack': a fault delivered ahead of the suspend handler is left to happen again, and a breakpoint is replayed; under 0028's switch; Intel side, ntdll.so

patches.name: 0032-ntdll-writecopy-pagefile-views-on-macos.patch
patches.subject: A copy-on-write view of a page-file section is mapped writable and shared outside Linux; 2XKO's copy protection needs it. From NotProton's creator

patches.name: 0033-win32u-draw-into-other-process-top-level-windows.patch
patches.subject: A window surface flushed to another process's top-level window is drawn at the window's visible origin, for the Riot Client's Electron window. From NotProton's creator

patches.name: 0034-kernelbase-device-paths-from-GetMappedFileNameW.patch
patches.subject: GetMappedFileNameW answers with a device path (\Device\HarddiskVolume1\...), as Windows does, which copy protection checks. From NotProton's creator

patches.name: 0035-user32-GetPointerDevice-stub.patch
patches.subject: GetPointerDevice exists and fails with ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER, for games that import it (2XKO). From NotProton's creator

patches.name: 0036-ntdll-writecopy-shared-only-for-riot.patch
patches.subject: 0032's shared copy-on-write views only in the Riot Client's and 2XKO's processes (Lion.exe, Lion-Win64-Shipping.exe, RiotClient*.exe, Riot Client.exe): every other program keeps its own writes to such a view, as on Windows. WINE_WRITECOPY_SHARED=1 or 0 turns it on or off

patches.name: 0037-ntdll-tcp-noopt-on-request.patch
patches.subject: WINE_TCP_NOOPT=1, or NotProton's notproton-tcp-noopt file beside the prefix, connects the process's TCP sockets with macOS's TCP_NOOPT (no MSS, window scale, SACK or timestamps), which Red Dead Online needs; from NotProton's creator's wineserver patch, set from ntdll on the same socket; off by default; both sides, ntdll.so

patches.name: 0039-dwrite-fontset-matching-fonts-by-family.patch
patches.subject: IDWriteFontSet::GetMatchingFonts by family, weight, stretch and style, which was a stub: it returns the family's fonts, the closest first, so a program built on GPUI (Swofty Launcher) finds its fonts instead of stopping with "failed to resolve font"; both sides, dwrite.dll

patches.name: 0040-directmanipulation-viewport-set-up.patch
patches.subject: A Direct Manipulation viewport can be set up (event handler, Enable, the manager's Activate, the update manager's Update) and never gets a contact, as nothing in Wine routes a pointer to it, so a program that needs the set-up to succeed opens its window; both sides, directmanipulation.dll

patches.name: 0041-kernelbase-FindPackagesByPackageFamily.patch
patches.subject: FindPackagesByPackageFamily, which Wine 11.21 does not have, exists in kernelbase.dll, and kernel32.dll forwards to it. It reports no packages (count 0, ERROR_SUCCESS), as GetPackagesByPackageFamily does. EA SPORTS FC 27's activation looks it up in KERNEL32.dll, and without it the game ends at "There is a problem with your game's setup. Please reinstall your game."; both sides, kernelbase.dll and kernel32.dll

patches.name: 0042-controls-diagnostics.patch
patches.subject: What only diagnostics on writes to the pad's log, kept apart from the controls' patches

patches.name: 0043-win32u-shm-surface-flush-without-the-user-lock.patch
patches.subject: A window drawn from another process is not flushed while Wine's USER lock is held. Forza Horizon 5's Xbox sign-in page (WebView2) stopped on Wine's lock check there, and the game closed with it

patches.name: 0031-ntdll-diagnostic-stores-on-demand.patch
